speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information whether the Government will more proactively police the Internet and block violent content that can be accessible to children and youths in Singapore.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: As much as possible, the Government will ensure they can do so safely.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: This includes protecting them from undesirable material such as violent content.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: Parents may subscribe to such services to manage their children’s access to websites and online services.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: The Media Literacy Council (MLC) has also been promoting safe and responsible online behaviour.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: They have developed resources and public education activities to encourage online users, including our young, to exercise judgement about the content that they come across online.
